test_policy.notes: ACT/SAT are not required for admission; they may be submitted for placement or as supplemental information. Admission criteria can be met by any one of: top 25% of class, 3.00 unweighted competency GPA, ACT 22 (24 nonresident) or SAT 1120 (1180 nonresident), plus course competencies. Some programs have higher thresholds.

requirements.notes: Application fee is $55 Arizona residents, $85 domestic nonresidents, $90 international nonresidents. Applicants can use the ASU application or the Common App. The Common Data Set lists essay and recommendations as not considered; teacher/counselor recommendation counts and interview policy are not stated on the admissions pages.

deadlines.label: Priority admission date (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: ASU admits on a rolling basis; Nov. 1 is the published priority date. Nursing (BSN) direct admission also uses a Nov. 1 priority date.

deadlines.label: Regular admission date (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: The /apply/first-year/admission page says Jan. 15; the /apply/first-year page says Feb. 1. Notification dates are not published (rolling).

deadlines.label: FAFSA priority filing date
deadlines.notes: Applies to U.S. citizens/eligible noncitizens; international students are not eligible for federal aid.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Automatic exemption for U.S. citizens/permanent residents and citizens of listed English-speaking countries. Form-based exemptions: 48 transferable U.S. college credits (GPA 2.50+, incl. 6 credits first-year English); 2 years US high school (juniors+seniors) with ACT English 23+ or SAT EBRW 580+; 4 years US high school; or secondary diploma from an institution where English was the sole medium of instruction. Scores must be no more than 2 years old at start date.

english.notes: General programs, exams taken before 2026-01-21. Higher for specific programs: Nursing BSN 76, Fulton Engineering 79, Cronkite Journalism 100. Paper edition not accepted; Home Edition accepted for exams on/after 2026-01-21.

aid.notes: International students do not qualify for federal/state aid. Merit-based New American University Scholarship (NAMU) is awarded to a limited number of qualified international undergraduates; colleges/departments also award scholarships. From the Common Data Set: 3,344 nonresidents received non-need-based aid from the college, avg $12,660.

majors.program: Engineering and Computer Science BS (Fulton Schools)
majors.notes: Most Fulton majors (e.g. Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Computer Science BS) need more than the university minimum: SAT 1210 or ACT 24, or 3.00 GPA, or top 25% of class, plus all high school math and science competencies. Engineering (BSE), Computer Science (BA) and some others need only general university requirements.

Direct admission: top 10% of class, or 3.80 competency GPA, or 3.50 GPA with ACT 25/SAT 1230. Priority date Nov. 1; spaces limited; others placed in BS Community Health. Offered at Downtown Phoenix, Polytechnic and West Valley, not Tempe.

sat.note: ASU admissions pages say to have the College Board send scores to ASU but do not print a numeric SAT code; look it up in the College Board code search.

act.note: ASU admissions pages say to have ACT send scores to ASU but do not print a numeric ACT code; look it up at act.org.

toefl.note: ASU institutional code; only electronic score reports accepted.

ielts.note: No institution code is needed or listed.
